claims.wording: DissectMac offers a drive treemap with folder drill-down, name search and filters.
claims.excerpt: Click into a block to go deeper, search by name, or filter to Xcode, Docker, node_modules, disk images, archives and iOS backups.
claims.conditions: Documented behavior only; coverage and scan speed not measured.

claims.wording: Vendor states macOS 12 Monterey and later, including macOS 26, on Apple Silicon and Intel.
claims.excerpt: DissectMac runs on macOS 12 Monterey and later, including macOS 26, on both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
claims.conditions: Separate Silicon and x64 DMG links advertised; no binary downloaded or compatibility tested.

claims.wording: The storage map, search and live CPU, memory and battery stats are free; in-app deletion and app/residue removal require Pro.
claims.excerpt: The map, search and monitor are free. / Everything in Free + / Delete files within the app / App uninstaller with residue cleanup
claims.conditions: No account/no time limit claimed in homepage FAQ. Do not imply all search variants are free: pricing lists Super Power search under Pro.

claims.wording: Current advertised Pro offer is $12.99 one-time before government taxes, with lifetime access and future updates; pricing labels this Festival Sale against $14.99.
claims.excerpt: $14.99 Festival Sale / $12.99 one-time / excl. govt. taxes; Your purchase includes lifetime access to all current features and future updates.
claims.conditions: Dollar symbol only; ISO currency, region, device count, sale expiry and checkout total not verified. No checkout opened. Refresh within 30 days and before publication; do not promise permanent price.

claims.wording: Terms grant a revocable, non-exclusive, non-transferable personal or commercial software-use licence.
claims.excerpt: We grant you a revocable, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the DissectMac software for personal or commercial purposes in accordance with the license you have purchased.
claims.conditions: Not an open-source grant or screenshot redistribution permission. Source availability not verified.

claims.wording: Vendor describes selecting unwanted items and moving them to Trash inside Pro, plus app uninstall and leftover cleanup.
claims.excerpt: Select what you don't need and move it to the Trash from inside the app ... Everything goes to the Trash first
claims.conditions: Not tested; exact confirmation/approval granularity and exceptions unverified. Trash movement is not immediate reclaimed free space or guaranteed recovery.

claims.wording: Vendor says scans run locally without uploading filenames, folder structure or scan results, while Sentry crash reporting and payment/licence services are used.
claims.excerpt: We do not store, upload, or transmit your individual file names, folder structures, or the results of your disk scans to any server. / we use Sentry.io for automated crash reporting.
claims.conditions: Policy assertion, not network audit. Do not call the entire product network-free or telemetry-free. Privacy page uses subscription wording despite explicit one-time pricing; preserve that discrepancy, do not infer recurring billing.

claims.conditions: Vendor disclosure only; signing/notarization not independently checked; no installation or Gatekeeper changes.
